text_block_list.text:
I came to watch Tokai Teio run
in an exhibition race—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's Tokai Teio~! Everyone present today
is so totally, extremely lucky!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The strongest and coolest of them all,
that's who I am—Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy this scene
from a living legend~!

True to her word, Tokai Teio
secured an effortless victory.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio... What an overwhelming run...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Man, calling herself the strongest Horse Girl
might not actually be an exaggeration!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, as expected of me!
Total piece of cake♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An effortless triumph, indeed.
A magnificent run, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, President! You came to watch?
Hey, hey, wasn't I amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as expected. Such a majestic stride—
allow me to offer my praise—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Tokai Teio!
We're looking forward to the Winning Live too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, President! I'm happy to hear that,
but... there's something I gotta do first!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I look forward to a performance
equal to your race earlier, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Make sure to keep your eyes glued on me!

With light, buoyant steps, Tokai Teio commanded
the crowd's undivided attention—

Maintaining her perfect 'undefeated' record
on the stage as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm just getting started!
It doesn't end here!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Keep on cheering way, waaaay more
for the undefeated Lady Teio!

Symboli Rudolf watched the stage for a while,
deep in sentimental thought.
